name: map-posters
description: Design a personalized map poster gift of any place in ChatGPT, then order a printed poster on mapbuilder.app.

defaultPrompt: Make an anniversary gift: a heart map poster of Lisbon, where we met, for Ana & Tom.
I need a housewarming gift: a map poster of my friend's new neighborhood in Austin.
Design a map poster of my mom's hometown for Mother's Day.
interface.longDescription: Make a personalized gift in minutes: a map poster of a place that means something. The city where you met, your wedding venue, a first home, a hometown, a favourite trip. Perfect for anniversaries, weddings, Valentine's Day, Mother's and Father's Day, housewarmings, graduations, birthdays and goodbye gifts. Choose a template, add names, a date or a message, and change fonts, colors and the map's shape (heart, circle and more). Add pins for the places that matter. See a live preview right in the chat, then save it or order a printed poster, framed poster or canvas on mapbuilder.app.

positive.description: 1. A personalized gift request, made into a poster. No account needed.
positive.prompt: I need an anniversary gift for my wife. We met in Lisbon. Can you make a heart map poster for Ana & Tom with "Where we met" underneath?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls create_poster with place Lisbon, template Heart, title Ana & Tom and subtitle Where we met. A live preview of the poster is shown in the chat with Save and Buy printed poster buttons, and the reply mentions the printed price with free shipping.

positive.prompt: What map poster templates do you have?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls list_poster_templates and lists the template names.

positive.description: 3. A poster of a city with the place name, country and coordinates filled in.
positive.prompt: Make a Classic map poster of Paris.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls create_poster with place Paris and template Classic. The preview shows a poster of Paris with PARIS, FRANCE and Paris's coordinates as its text; nothing from the template's original city remains.

positive.description: 4. Changing the design in plain words. Requires the poster from case 1 in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: Put it on a black background and use a script font like Great Vibes for the title.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls edit_poster with the draftId from case 1, background black and the title's font Great Vibes. The new preview shows a black poster whose text is still readable.

positive.description: 5. Pins on the poster's map. Requires the poster from case 1.
positive.prompt: Add a heart pin at Praça do Comércio and zoom out a little.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls edit_poster with a pin at Praça do Comércio (icon heart) and a negative zoomBy. The new preview shows the pin and a wider view.

negative.description: Unrelated factual question should not invoke Map Posters.
negative.prompt: What is the population of Paris?
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant answers normally and does not call any Map Posters tool.

negative.description: Digital files are not sold or offered in ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Send me the poster as a print-ready PDF I can download.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that a file download isn't available here; the poster can be saved or ordered as a printed poster on mapbuilder.app. It does not call a tool to produce or sell a file.

negative.description: Purchases are never completed inside ChatGPT.
negative.prompt: Order the poster now and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant explains that ordering happens on mapbuilder.app through the Buy printed poster button and does not attempt to take payment or call any tool to place an order.

review.commerce_description: Physical goods only: printed map posters, framed posters and canvas prints, fulfilled by Printful and shipped free. The app links to checkout on mapbuilder.app (Stripe); no payment is taken in ChatGPT and no digital goods are sold.

publication.release_notes: First release: design personalized map poster gifts of any place in ChatGPT from templates, change text, fonts, colors, the map's shape and pins by describing them, then save or order a printed poster on mapbuilder.app.
